abstract: This study adopts a randomized, open label, placebo-controlled, multicenter trial design. OS was the primary endpoint, and eligible subjects were randomly divided into 1:1 groups and received TQB2868 injection and anlotinib hydrochloride capsules combined with chemotherapy, compared to placebo combined with chemotherapy.
